description: 金融研訓院網路書店新書快訊 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 金融監督管理委員會銀行局. 為金融研訓院最新出版的雜誌或叢書。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 金融監督管理委員會銀行局. Its tags are 求學及進修. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-12-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
